mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, t.merchant_name AS transactionName, ec.expense_category_id AS categoryId, ec.category_name AS categoryName, t.amount, t.transacted_at AS transactedAt FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN expense_category ec ON t.expense_category_id = ec.expense_category_id ORDER BY t.transacted_at DESC, t.transaction_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.expense_category_id AS categoryId, ec.category_name AS categoryName, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN expense_category ec ON t.expense_category_id = ec.expense_category_id GROUP BY t.expense_category_id, ec.category_name ORDER BY amount DESC, t.expense_category_id ASC
